# GDCT

GDCT gives Obsidian a modern appearance with balanced colors and clear typography. The recorded description credits subtle interface accents and readable contrast across panes with reducing visual clutter, and the theme index lists light mode only.

![GDCT screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bcdavasconcelos/Obsidian-GDCT/HEAD/gdct.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "GDCT"
    author: "bcdavasconcelos"
    repo:   "bcdavasconcelos/Obsidian-GDCT"
    slug:   "gdct"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/gdct"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/bcdavasconcelos/Obsidian-GDCT"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bcdavasconcelos/Obsidian-GDCT/HEAD/gdct.png"

    modes: ["light"]
    about: "Apply GDCT to give Obsidian a clean, modern appearance with balanced colors and clear typography. Reduce visual clutter with subtle UI accents and readable contrast across panes."
}
```
